A.query:
WITH
  toInt64({{.start_timestamp_nano}}) AS start_ns,
  toInt64({{.end_timestamp_nano}}) AS end_ns,
  roster AS (
    SELECT host, telemetry
    FROM values('host String, telemetry String',
        /* loom:roster:begin */
        ('example-always', 'always'), ('example-when-awake', 'when_awake')
        /* loom:roster:end */
    )
  ),
  seen AS (
    SELECT if(resources_string['host.name'] != '', resources_string['host.name'], resources_string['host.id']) AS host,
           countIf(attributes_string['loom.kind'] = 'host.export') AS exports,
           maxIf(timestamp, attributes_string['loom.kind'] = 'host.export') AS last_export_ns,
           maxIf(timestamp, attributes_string['loom.kind'] NOT IN ('', 'host.export')) AS last_other_ns
    FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
    WHERE timestamp >= {{.start_timestamp_nano}}
      AND timestamp < {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
    GROUP BY host
  ),
  judged AS (
    SELECT r.host AS host,
           if(r.telemetry = 'always', 900, 86400) AS threshold_seconds,
           ifNull(s.exports, 0) AS n_exports,
           toInt64(ifNull(s.last_export_ns, 0)) AS le_ns,
           toInt64(ifNull(s.last_other_ns, 0)) AS lo_ns
    FROM roster AS r
    LEFT JOIN seen AS s ON r.host = s.host
  )
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(end_ns, 1000000000)) AS ts,
       host,
       if(lo_ns > 0 AND intDiv(end_ns - lo_ns, 1000000000) <= threshold_seconds,
          'exporter_silent', 'host_silent') AS state,
       toFloat64(if(n_exports = 0, intDiv(end_ns - start_ns, 1000000000), intDiv(end_ns - le_ns, 1000000000))
                 - threshold_seconds) AS value
FROM judged
ORDER BY host

annotations.description: Roster host {{$labels.host}} has sent no host.export log for {{$value}} s past its limit (900 s for telemetry: always, 86400 s for when_awake). The state label splits the cause: exporter_silent means the host still sends other Loom logs (the exporter or pipeline stopped, the host is up); host_silent means it sends nothing (the host or daemon is down, or it never exported over OTLP). The roster inside the query is rendered from fleet-gitops hosts.yml (services.loom-daemon.expected: running); the COMMITTED roster holds example-* placeholders so an unrendered import fires loudly rather than staying silently healthy. Re-render on every hosts.yml change. A host that never exported in the 48 h window counts as silent for the whole window. Issue #11198.
